fields.value: Release of the community aerosol dynamics model MAFOR v2 and the urban case dataset published in Karl et al., GMD, 2021

dsDescriptionValue.value: This is the release of the community aerosol dynamics model MAFOR (v1.9.9) and the urban case dataset published with the GMD article (Matthias Karl, Liisa Pirjola, Tiia Grönholm, Mona Kurppa, Srinivasan Anand, Xiaole Zhang, Andreas Held, Rolf Sander, Miikka Dal Maso, David Topping, Shuai Jiang, Leena Kangas and Jaakko Kukkonen: "Description and evaluation of the community aerosol dynamics model MAFOR v2.0"). The program version v1.9.9 of the MAFOR model code was used in the article for simulation of the urban case scenario and three numerical experiments. The program is an open source code subject to the GPL-3 license.
